author: @LEC_Wooloo
raw_text: Sources indicate that Ruler is in advanced discussions to return to LCK and join Gen.G for the upcoming 2026 season.
summary: 룰러가 2026시즌을 앞두고 LCK 젠지로 복귀하기 위한 협상을 진행 중입니다.
summary_en: Ruler is in advanced talks to return to the LCK and join Gen.G for the 2026 season.
summary_zh: 消息称 Ruler 正就重回 LCK 加盟 Gen.G 参加 2026 赛季进行深入谈判。

author: 涵艺
raw_text: Kanavi is expected to evaluate multiple offers from top LPL and LCK teams as his contract approaches expiration.
summary: 카나비가 계약 만료를 앞두고 LPL과 LCK 상위권 팀들의 여러 제안을 검토할 것으로 보입니다.
summary_en: Kanavi is expected to evaluate multiple offers from top LPL and LCK teams as his contract expires.
summary_zh: 随着合同即将到期，Kanavi 预计将评估来自 LPL 和 LCK 顶级战队的多个报价。

author: Sheep Esports
raw_text: Caps has reached a verbal agreement with G2 Esports to extend his contract through the 2026 LEC season.
summary: 캡스가 G2 에스포츠와 2026년 LEC 시즌까지 계약을 연장하기로 구두 합의했습니다.
summary_en: Caps has reached a verbal agreement with G2 Esports to extend his contract through the 2026 LEC season.
summary_zh: Caps 已与 G2 Esports 达成口头协议，将合同延长至 2026 LEC 赛季结束。
